text: 出去。嗨，別為奧米諾斯感到難過。  暫時保密對他有好處。我會自己決定什麼對我有利。  不祥之兆？我們正準備
透透氣。有興趣加入嗎？賽巴斯蒂安，你是個騙子。我的天啊。 You swore you'd never engage in anything to do with dark magic again.我的天啊。
不，我沒有。 I said I understood you wanting that. I'd never swear to give up on finding a cure for Anne. You don't know when to stop, do you?我的天啊。 I know when not to stop. Leave this alone, Finus.
